obligationRows.requirement: Every reachable nested refusal has a literal runtime witness; accepted A0 QuickEntry state statically dominates source code-point, Unicode-scalar, UTF-8, and issue-count excess branches.
Complete-draft commits into one measure, one section, and the document with exact structure and focus behavior.
Source text, base revision, target, issue codes, status, and lane each stale independently.
Targets must exist and event, measure, and section destinations must own the target boundary.
Positive reduced PPQ durations commit at valid values and refuse zero, noncanonical, or wrong exact sums.
Command shape, UTF-16 ranges, stable IDs, and the 256/2000 caller-text bounds are checked before allocation.
Reachable collection and completion maxima commit; accepted-state event and meter limits algebraically dominate the defensive timeline maximum.
Every reachable first-excess cap refuses before later stages; UTF-8 byte excess is dominated by the scalar/code-point cap.
Successful allocations carry exact source provenance, structural preorder, and cardinality.
Factory null-return refusal stops at every allocating structural position.
Occupied-ID collision refusal stops at every allocating structural position.
Both join variants commit with a hostile refuse-on-any-call factory and zero calls.
F2 refusal is atomic after exactly one validation call and before bookmark/history publication.
F3 refusal is atomic after exactly two validation calls and before bookmark/history publication.
History retained-size refusal is atomic after both validation gates and exact bookmark calculation.
Each plan kind has a chained apply, undo, and redo trio with exact row movement, revisions, null commands, and stable identities.
Recovery work counts returned insertable-array positions rather than sparse global ordinals.
Every retained diagnostic is typed, sanitized, sorted, bounded, primary-correlated, and stage-correlated.
A positive transition for every plan kind equals an independent whole-document transform.
Five base/transposed pairs commute with the reviewed spelling-preserving transform and inverse.
Thirty controls change exactly one input field from an accepted baseline to an independently derived refusal.
Every source-frozen semantic backdoor key is refused by exact shape validation.
Complete-draft warnings commit only with exact code/range order and refuse a missing acknowledgement.
Resolved T0 duration and caller-required duration each commit only in their exact branch.
